topic: Account-Based Marketing and B2B Sales Enablement
headline: 'Tishman Speyer Account-Based Growth Engine' has won Bronze in Industry - Property at the B2B Awards 2026
keyNotes: Tishman Speyer won an award for completely changing how they sell their services by focusing their efforts on specific, important companies instead of trying to reach everyone.
This new, targeted way of working helped them significantly improve how many potential clients they could connect with.
It also led to a big increase in the number of those connections that actually turned into new business deals.
Crucially, this more focused approach made their selling efforts much more efficient, meaning they got better results for the money they spent.
question: If Tishman Speyer achieved significant improvements in connecting with clients and closing deals by focusing their efforts on specific, important companies, how might a similar focused approach change how you tackle a big project or goal in your own work?
